defaultCriteriaText: Start from the existing knowledge base and keep raw candidates separate from verified sources. Evaluate EVERY admitted source: a relevance verdict (core/context/off_topic) and 3-10 supported claims with a verbatim quote, locator, statement type and limitations in the claims table. Then consolidate identical statements across sources into one claim with several pieces of evidence and record contradictions. A verified but unevaluated source counts as open work.
